components.name: accordion
components.description: Collapsible disclosure rows. WAI-ARIA accordion pattern.

components.name: button
components.description: An action or a link that looks like one. Tones, loading, icons, focusable when disabled.

components.name: spinner
components.description: An indeterminate loading indicator with a live status label.

components.name: separator
components.description: A line between groups of content, with an optional label; solid, dashed or dotted.

components.name: kbd
components.description: A keyboard shortcut that adapts to the platform (⌘ on Apple, Ctrl elsewhere).

components.name: skeleton
components.description: A loading placeholder that swaps to the real content.

components.name: badge
components.description: A status label, a count or a dot, in six tones.

components.name: alert
components.description: A message box with a tone icon, title, description, actions and dismiss.

components.name: avatar
components.description: A picture with initials as the fallback, a presence dot, or a stacked group.

components.name: card
components.description: A surface with an image, a real heading, content and actions; optionally one link.

components.name: progress
components.description: A progress bar or ring, determinate or indeterminate, or a meter.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: A hint on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: popover
components.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger; a hover card with openOn: hover.

components.name: dialog
components.description: A native modal dialog: centred, a sheet from any edge, or an alert dialog.

components.name: menu
components.description: A dropdown or context menu from a list of rows, with keyboard support and typeahead.

components.name: toast
components.description: Queued messages in a corner, paused while read and announced to screen readers.

components.name: input
components.description: A text field with its label, help text and error wired up.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox, or a group from a list.

components.name: radio
components.description: One choice from a list, as native radios.

components.name: switch
components.description: An on/off setting: a native checkbox with the switch role.

components.name: toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed, or a group: a segmented control or formatting buttons.
components.snippet: <Toggle label="View" items={[{ value: "list", label: "List" }, { value: "board", label: "Board" }]} />

components.name: toolbar
components.description: A row of buttons: a joined button group or a spaced toolbar, one tab stop, arrow keys.

components.name: slider
components.description: Pick a number or a range along a track: native range inputs, marks, a live value.

components.name: number
components.description: A number with - and + buttons: native number input, steps, limits, press and hold.

components.name: otp
components.description: A one-time code in boxes, over one native input: typing, paste and SMS autofill.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Panels picked from a row of tabs with a sliding indicator.
components.snippet:
const Settings = defineTabs();
<Settings label="Settings" items={[{ id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', content: <Profile /> }]} />

components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: The path to the current page, collapsing a long trail.
components.snippet:
const Trail = defineBreadcrumb();
<Trail items={[{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Settings' }]} />

components.name: pagination
components.description: Numbered pages with gaps, previous and next; buttons or links.
components.snippet:
const Pages = definePagination();
<Pages count={24} page={page} onChange={setPage} />

components.name: stepper
components.description: Progress through the steps of a task.
components.snippet:
const Checkout = defineStepper();
<Checkout value={1} items={[{ label: 'Cart' }, { label: 'Payment' }]} />

components.name: select
components.description: A field that opens a list to choose one value, or several as chips; a native select underneath.

components.name: combobox
components.description: A text field that suggests as you type: filtered rows or server results, chips, free text.

components.name: tags
components.description: Tags (chips): labels, removable filters, links, or choices to pick one or several of.

components.name: command
components.description: A command palette, on the page or as a ⌘K dialog: type, move, run.

components.name: calendar
components.description: A month grid to choose a day, a range or several days; locale week start; ISO dates.

components.name: datepicker
components.description: A date field: type a date in your own format or pick it from a calendar; one day or a range.

components.name: table
components.description: A data table from your rows: sorting, choosing rows, pages, loading and empty states.

components.name: rating
components.description: Stars (or any symbol) to give or show a score; whole or half steps; native radios.

components.name: timeline
components.description: Events in order: dots, icons or cards; vertical, alternating or horizontal; ISO times in the locale.

components.name: empty
components.description: An empty state: what is missing and what to do about it.

components.name: carousel
components.description: Slides in a scroll-snapping row: swipe, buttons, dots; autoplay with a pause button.

components.name: resizable
components.description: Panels with handles to drag or move by keys; min and max; sizes kept per browser.

components.name: sidebar
components.description: App navigation down the side: links, sections that open, group headings, header and footer; folds into a rail of icons.

components.name: navmenu
components.description: A site header navigation: links, and buttons that open panels of links with icons and descriptions, on hover or press.

components.name: colorpicker
components.description: Pick a colour: saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, a text field for hex, rgb, hsl or oklch, swatches and the eyedropper.

components.name: scrollarea
components.description: A scrolling region whose edges show where more content is; follows new content like a chat.
